name: film-stage
title: Film Stage
description: A stage for a sequence of timed scenes with a transport: it owns the clock and the chrome (play, time bar, speed, sound), mounts the scene for the current moment, cuts or crossfades between scenes, and can draw any moment on request for export.

meta.when: Content the project draws itself from a time: an animated explainer, a story in scenes, a slideshow with narration, a film assembled from markup, SVG or canvas. Each scene gets its own local time and draws from it, so any frame can be drawn again exactly. The stage is the clock other things follow: scrubber, scene-strip, captions and hotspots work inside it as they do inside video-player, and narration audio is kept in step. For a video or sound file use video-player or audio-player; for motion tied to scrolling use scroll-scene; for a set of pictures a person pages through use carousel.
